page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highcpu-384 is a compute-optimized server instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 384 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, paired with 720.0 GB of system memory. This configuration results in a resource density of approximately 1.88 GB of RAM per vCPU, aligning it with high-density compute workloads that require massive parallel processing capabilities without a proportional demand for memory capacity.

The instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached storage options, and workloads cannot leverage hardware-accelerated graphics or tensor processing. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high core count provide a dense compute profile suitable for highly parallelized CPU-bound tasks, optimizing resource spend for compute-heavy workloads rather than memory-intensive or storage-heavy operations.
Appropriate workloads for the c4d-highcpu-384 include large-scale batch processing, high-performance computing simulations, intensive CPU-based rendering, and distributed build systems.
